actual: generate_typescript(kind='screen', name='it_console') emits two exported function provision implementations: POST /admin/users with ProvisionIn and POST /ot/theaters with TheaterIn. Saving its code makes TypeScript fail TS2323/TS2393 at lines618/733.
evidence: MCP functions43. Exact signatures: export function provision(body: ProvisionIn): Promise<ProvisionedUserOut>; export function provision(body: TheaterIn): Promise<TheaterOut>, both with function bodies. npm run build handbook passes then tsc reports duplicate exported variable/implementation. No backend business write.
expected: Generated screen module should compile with distinct exported operation names, preserving both real endpoints and their contracts.
steps: Call generate_typescript({kind:'screen',name:'it_console'}), save returned code in src/generated/it_console.ts and run tsc --noEmit.
title: IT console TypeScript generator emits duplicate provision implementations
